reviewScope: Supplementary classification of the remaining technical-view lexical candidates. The accessible name for internal segments, its separator and template fragments, and the focused-module image label map to existing semantic entries in the viewer/configurator batch; this file classifies the remaining SVG/DOM, geometry and rendering values.
limitations: Inventory only; runtime and localization resources remain unchanged.
V5 segment names and measured dimensions are dynamic domain parameters in the separately classified accessibility template.
